same symptom observed on multiple independent agent/** branches
local MCP tunnel is also disconnected, so local Windows validation cannot substitute

invariants: candidate ref is storage/development only and does not satisfy ordinary agent/** push gate
do not merge candidate ref into private/neko-overlay-v1
do not update stable release manifest from candidate evidence
do not mark candidate work green from static review alone
when execution recovers, resync latest private/neko-overlay-v1 before replaying candidate increments
agent/companion-runtime-v1 must then run reuse-first, architecture-freeze, plugin-admission, overlay, patched-product, QQ and micro-soak gates on ordinary push
gate failures must be fixed in implementation/evidence; never remove or weaken a gate

ordinary agent/** push actually starts and completes machine gate
plugin admission and release-readiness invariants green
